specification.name: Budget and application filings
specification.about: The budget filings, advice letters and applications each program administrator files for a filing cycle, as the engine's Measure and ProgramCost inputs.

version.name: Legacy CEDARS budget filings, 2017-2031
version.summary: The layout of legacy CEDARS' record-level budget filings download for the filings of 2017 to 2031. Recorded from the download's header as CEDARS publishes it, for the years imported from it: those years were filed and checked in legacy CEDARS, so no filing is checked against this version and it is never changed.

file_format.files: one comma-delimited file per table, in a .zip

tables.name: Filings
tables.guidance: The budget filings download: one row per measure record, with its program and CEDARS' CET outputs. Also the layout of the archived 2028-2031 snapshot.
